senses.gloss: 2. मथ् mfn. (ifc.) destroying, a destroyer (cf. मधुमथ्)
मथ् m. See मथिन्.
मथ m. = माथ, g. ज्वलादि.
मथा ind. a Nidhana formula, Lāṭy.
माथ m. (√ मथ्) churning, stirring, W.
hurting, killing, destruction, Śatr.
illness, disease, L.
a way, road, L. (cf. माठ).
मथक m. N. of a man
pl. his descendants g. यस्कादि (v.l. for, मन्थक).
माथक m. a destroyer, Bālar.
मथन् (only instr. मथ्ना), a piece of wood for producing fire by attrition, BhP.
मथन mf(ई, once आ)n. rubbing, stirring, shaking, harassing, destroying (with gen. or ifc.), MBh.; R. &c.
मथन m. Premna Spinosa (the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition), L.
मथन n. the act of rubbing, friction, BhP.
stirring or whirling round, churning or producing by churning, MBh.; R.; Pur.
hurting, annoying, injury, destruction, R.; Ratnāv.
मथनाचल m. the mountain (Mandara q.v.) used as a churning-stick (by the gods and Dānavas in churning the ocean of milk), BhP. (cf. मन्थ-शैत).
मथि (ifc.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 27) See उरा-, वस्त्र- and हविर्-म॑थि (मथीना॑न्, RV. viii, 53, 8 prob. w.r. for मतीना॑म्; cf. मथि॑न्).
मथित mfn. stirred round, churned or produced by churning, RV.
shaken, agitated, afflicted, hurt, destroyed, MBh.; R.; Hariv.
dislocated, disjointed, Suśr.
मथित m. N. of a descendant of Yama (and supposed author of RV. x, 19), RAnukr.
मथित n. buttermilk churned without water, Kauś.; MBh. &c.
मथित—पादप mfn. (a wood) whose trees are damaged or destroyed, Hariv.
मथितोरस mfn. one whose breast is pierced or wounded (by arrows), ib. (v.l. व्यथ्˚).
मथितृ mfn. (ifc.) crushing, destroying, Ānand.

मथि॑न् m. (strong stem, म॑न्थन्, older म॑न्था; middle मथि॑न् or मथि॑ [q.v.]; sg. nom. म॑न्थास् acc. म॑न्थाम् [for मन्थानम् See मन्थान under √ मन्थ्] ; instr. मथा॑ du. मथि॑भ्याम् pl. मथि॑भ्यस् &c. [cf. पथिन् and Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83 &c.]; for मथीना॑म् See मथि above) a churning-stick, any stick or staff for stirring or churning, RV. &c. &c.
the penis, L.
a thunderbolt, L.
wind, L.
मथीन ˚नति (artificial Nom. fr. मथिन्), Siddh. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 13.
मथ्न॑ (only मथ्ना॑, RV. i, 181, 5), prob. w.r. for मथ्र॑.
मथ्य mfn. to be rubbed out of (see उल्मुक-म्˚)
to be extracted or produced from (see सिन्धु-म्˚).
मथ्र॑ mfn. shaken, agitated, whirling, RV. (cf. मथ्न॑).
मथव्य᳙ prob. w.r. for मध्˚, AV.
मथात See माथाथ.
मथु m. a proper N. (= मधु; cf. माथव॑).
मथुर m. (√ मथ्?) N. of a man (cf. माथुर)
मथुरा f. See next.

मथुरा f. N. of various towns (esp. of an ancient town now called Muttra and held in great honour as the birthplace of Kṛṣṇa; situated in the province of Agra on the right bank of the Yamunā or Jumna; described in VP. xii, 1 as having been founded by Śatru-ghna; accord. to Kull. on Mn. ii, 19 it forms part of a district called Brahmarṣi, belonging to Śūra-sena), AV.Pariś.; Hariv.; Pur. &c.
मथूरा f. = मथुरा above, L.
माथुर mf(ई)n. coming from or born in or belonging to Mathurā, Hariv.; Kathās.
relating or belonging to Mathurā, Cat.
composed by Mathurā-nātha, ib.
माथुर m. an inhabitant of Mathurā, Hariv.
N. of a son of Citra-gupta, Cat.
of the keeper of a gambling house, Mṛcch.
मथुरा—काण्ड n. N. of wk.
मथुरा—गुह्य-वर्नण n. N. of wk.
मथुरा—चम्पू f. N. of wk.
मथुरा—तीर्थ-महात्म्य n. N. of wk.
मथुरा—दास m. N. of the author of the drama Vṛṣabhānujā.
मथुरा—नाटक n. N. of a drama.
मथुरा—नाथ m. (also ˚र-न्˚) ‘lord of Mathurā’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
N. of various men and authors (also with शुक्ल, चक्रवर्तिन् and तर्क-वाग्-ईश)
मथुरा—नाथ—जाति-माला f. N. of wk.
मथुरा—नाथ—राय m. N. of a man, Cat.
मथुरा—ना˚थीय n. N. of wk.
मथुरा—महिमन् m. N. of wk.
मथुरा—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
मथुरा—माहात्म्य-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
मथुरा—सेतु m. N. of wk.
मथुरेश m. ‘lord of Mathurā’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, L.
of various authors (also with विद्यालंकार), Cat.
माथितिक mfn. dealing in buttermilk (मथित), Pāṇ. v, 3, 83, Vārtt. 2, Pat.
माथव॑ m. patron. (= माधव), ŚBr.
माथाथ n. N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.
माथिक m. Nimba Asadirachta, L.
माथुरी f. N. of various works.
माथुर—देश्य mfn. coming from the Mathurā district, MBh.
माथुरक m. pl. the inhabitants of Mathurā, Cat.
